verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents ingesting traces, logs, and metrics into one backend via OpenTelemetry and OTLP, and has a 'traces-metrics-logs' getting-started page and trace-relational query fields. That puts all three signals in one place for investigation. However, nothing in the evidence describes clicking from a span to its correlated logs or metrics, or any automatic linking by trace ID. Missing for 10: documented span-to-log navigation, span-to-metric correlation, trace-ID-based log linking, and hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end debugging workflow.
